prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup
Asset type: high-fidelity desktop web interface concept at 1440×900 for Ardor’s interactive User manual
Primary request: Design a complete web page screenshot for an interactive learning surface. This is Option C, “Control layers”.
Structure: a compact top navigation rail, then a three-band workspace. The upper 57% is an exploded but dimensionally aligned control map where the assembled pedal stays central and its control zones project outward into instructional layers. The middle 23% is a cause → gesture → result sequence. The bottom 20% is a dense flat combination ledger with PRESET MODE, LOOPER MODE and TUNER columns.
Interaction state: FS3 is selected and depressed with a red live ring. The sequence reads FS3, PRESS, Select preset 3 and shows slot 2 changing to slot 3. The ledger includes FS3 — Record / overdub.
Visual world: Ardor’s established playable nomenclature plate: graphite, slate, bone lettering, muted labels, hard hairline rules, live red only for active state, square geometry, calibrated ticks and bracket corners.
Subject/reference: preserve the supplied pedal’s proportions, four-switch corner layout, centered widescreen touchscreen, rear-center encoder, textured black enclosure and metal footswitches. Exploded means instructional projection, not physical disassembly.
Constraints: a usable web interface screenshot, not a poster; no browser chrome, marketing hero, floating rounded cards, gradients, neon glow, glass, decorative grid, extra controls, fake claims, or logos besides ARDOR.
